newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 15.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast's higher education minister, Saliou Toure, says that despite student unrest the current academic year will not be lost.
- Ivory Coast holds workshops for businessmen and women on progress towards creation of common market in the seven-nation Francophone West African Economic and Monetary Union (UEMOA) zone.

- Britain grants political asylum to former Ivorian student leader; students in northern town of Korhogo strike over academic and living conditions followings similar protests in West African nation's two main towns Abidjan and Bouake.

- Officials from West African ports of Abidjan in Ivory Coast and Dakar in Senegal meet to swap notes on the sector as part of efforts to learn from one another's experiences - Timber industry union SYNPERFOS-CI says some sawmills pay workers below minimum wage and regularly resort unfair dismissals; urges Ivorian government to intervene
